items.texto: Las coyunturas que duran años o décadas
items.escena: A clay calendar with many pages being flipped by the wind next to a growing young tree

items.texto: Las estructuras lentas que apenas cambian
items.escena: An ancient clay mountain with a very slow glacier and a huge old tree with deep roots
A single clay lightning bolt striking a small hill, a camera flash moment
Two clay armies of toy soldiers facing each other on a green field with small flags
A clay line chart arrow crashing down toward a broken piggy bank
A clay mountain range with a very slow turtle crawling across it
A clay tree growing from a sapling to a tall tree in three steps
A clay firework bursting quickly in the night sky
A clay model of an ancient island city with pyramid temples on a lake, some smoke rising from it
An old clay parchment scroll with a golden seal and a quill resting on a table
A clay bronze church bell ringing in a small tower at dawn
A clay revolutionary rider on horseback with a wide sombrero riding across a desert
